com: Recommended final cash offer by private equity firm EQT at £60 per share. The offer will be implemented by means of a Court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement and is expected to become effective in Q4 2026 or Q1 2027.

Recommended cash offer (scheme) by Toscafund (which already owns 24.36%) of 250p per share with an unlisted share alternative. Approaches had been previously received from Bridgepoint and Triton, following a strategic review but talks ended.
Recommended £1,015m offer (scheme) announced on 1 September 2026. 0.13% undertakings. Completion expected Q1 2027.

Helios consortium (which already owns 45.11%) has gone hostile, with 85p formal offer. StoneX had made an indicative offer of 110p, before withdrawing on 5 May, given the Helios Consortium's lack of support.

Genel made a recommended offer (scheme) of 357p per share on 2 July. DNO made a recommended higher competing bid on 1 September. On 25 September, Genel made an increased recommended offer of US$4.75 in cash plus a special dividend of US$0.99 per share (in aggregate 434p per share). Genel had received irrevocable undertakings in respect of approximately 39.1% of Capricorn's share capital.
Strategic review - in discussions with two parties.
Strategic review & formal sale process. Has not received an indicative offer but has held preliminary discussions with a small number of counterparties.
Discussions are with selected third parties as part of a private strategic review process.

Formal cash offer (scheme) from US ingredients group Ingredion Inc, valuing each share at up to 615p - 595p in cash plus permitted final and interim dividends of up to 20p. Follows proposal at same price.
Recommended cash offer (scheme), with undertakings in relation to 0.34%. Follows previous approach by TA Associates, which withdrew on 18 May 2026

Apollo had emerged with a higher 715p/share cash possible offer vs Castlelake’s 690p. On 6 August 2026, Castlelake confirmed that it did not intend to make an offer for easyJet. On the same day, Apollo announced a recommended offer to be implemented by way of a scheme of arrangement together with an alternative offer of 1 rollover share for each easyJet share. Completion expected by the end of Q1 2027.

On 23 June 2026, FirstCash announced a recommended cash offer of 600p per share plus dividends of up to 9p per share, to be effected by scheme of arrangement. On 16 July 2026, FirstCash announced a final recommended cash offer (scheme) for Ramsdens of 675p per share plus dividend of up to 9p per share. Scheme approved by shareholders on 10 August 2026. On 26 October 2026, CMA formally launched its phase 1 merger inquiry into FirstCash's acquisition of Ramsdens with a statutory deadline of 22 December 2026.

Recommended cash offer (scheme) of 23.07p per share plus special dividend of 4p and ordinary dividend of 0.9317p per share. Following a competing bid announced by Serica Energy on 26 July 2026, the Board's recommendation was withdrawn. On 7 August 2026, Ratio announced an increased recommended cash offer (scheme) of 28.82p per share plus special dividend of 4p per share and ordinary dividend of 0.9317p per share. 41.76% undertakings. On 13 August 2026, Serica Energy withdrew its offer.
Following four proposals, the latest being at 1,031.7p per share (with a 25% partial cash alternative), Prologis launches a recommended offer to be effected by way of a scheme of arrangement.
Formal sale process. The Board is not in any active discussions with any potential offeror
Recommended cash offer (scheme) of 503p per share plus dividend of up to 3p per share for all shares in Rotork by ABB Automation Holding UK Limited, a subsidiary of ABB Ltd.

Recommended cash offer (scheme) for Mitie by OCS Group International Limited, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of OCS Group Topco Limited, of 218.5p per share and a final dividend of 3.1p per share.

On 1 September 2026, Veritas Capital made a formal recommended offer at 932.8p per share in cash plus an interim dividend of 7.2p per share. Followed indicative offer by Veritas of 906.8p per share in cash plus an interim dividend of 7.2p per share. Offer expected to complete Q1 2027. On 28 September 2026, CVC Advisers Limited withdrew its indicative competing offer for Bodycote.

Recommended cash offer (scheme) of 59.1p per share by Bentley Park (UK) Limited, the parent company of Ultimate Finance Group Limited. Bentley Park had received irrevocable undertakings in respect of approximately 47.36% of Time Finance's share capital.

Genel Energy plc made a recommended offer (scheme) on 2 July. DNO made a recommended higher competing bid (scheme) on 1 September, at US$ 5.214 per share in cash, including a US$ 0.99 special dividend. Completion expected Q4 2026 or Q1 2027. On 17 September 2026, DNO announced a revised cash offer of US$5.214 per share without the special dividend component. Note DNO had separately made an approach for Genel. Following Genel's increased offer on 25 September, the Board's recommendation of the DNO offer has accordingly been withdrawn. On 28 September, DNO announced that the offer was final and would not be increased.
Strategic review & formal sale process. The Board expected interested parties to be invited to submit non-binding offers over approximately the coming four weeks.
Indicative all-share offer of 0.01108 new Greenland Energy share for each 80 Mile share.

Unsolicited preliminary approach in connection with a possible offer for all shares in SThree. The SThree Board rejects the offer and believes it significantly undervalues SThree and its future prospects.
Recommended all cash offer (scheme) of 235p per share by Avocet Bidco Limited, which is owned by Accel-KKR Capital Partners.

Recommended cash offer (scheme) of up to 88p per share, including a contingent consideration unit of 24p per share in the form of a loan note. Taboola.com had received irrevocable undertakings corresponding to 75.3% of Dianomi's shares. Completion expected before the end of 2026.
Assessment of strategic options. Pollen Street has initiated preliminary discussions with a limited number of third parties.

Recommended cash offer (scheme) of 615p per share (which followed an unsolicited non-binding indicative proposal of the same value). The offer follows three previous proposals from Ember, the first two of which were unequivocally rejected by the Board. Completion expected either late in the fourth quarter of 2026 or early in the first quarter of 2027.

Indicative offer of 470p in cash and 0.28 new RHI shares for every 10 Vesuvius shares. The proposal also includes the right to receive the interim dividend declared by Vesuvius of 7.1p per share. The latest proposal follows three previous proposals and is being evaluated by the Vesuvius Board.
DBAY and Colin Kingsnorth made two proposals (at 19p and 20p per share), which have been rejected
Indicative cash offer of 15p per share. The First Tin board is considering the proposal.

Non-binding cash proposal of 46p per share by Autobuses de Leon, S.L., a company jointly owned by CMC Group and Asterion Industrial Partners Fund III, FCR. Mobico's independent directors are "minded" to recommend the proposal to Mobico's shareholders.

Recommended €2.97/sh cash scheme from BAWAG PSK (€1.62bn), announced 14 Apr; Irish State (57.5%) irrevocably committed. Shareholders approved 30 Jul (91.28%); CCPC cleared 23 Jun. Awaiting ECB approval and High Court sanction (hearing 27 Oct); completion expected Q4 2026/Q1 2027. Rival interest: Axis Capital possible cash offer at €3.20 (2 Oct), no funding yet, now sounding out shareholders on a rollover; Scotchstone Capital also considering an offer (9 Oct), no terms. PTSB board dismissed both as highly speculative. Irish Panel rejected Axis's complaint about the sale process (12 Oct).

Possible cash offer of €3.20/sh (c.€1.74bn) announced 2 Oct, 7.7% above BAWAG's agreed €2.97. No funding committed yet; Axis is seeking financing partners and on 12 Oct invited shareholders to indicate interest in rolling over part of their holdings. PTSB board dismissed the approach as highly speculative and remains behind BAWAG. Irish Panel rejected Axis's complaint about the sale process (12 Oct).

Scotchstone Capital confirmed on 9 Oct that it was considering an offer; no terms disclosed. PTSB said it had had no contact with Scotchstone and had received no proposal, calling the announcement highly speculative. BAWAG's recommended €2.97/sh scheme remains on track (sanction hearing 27 Oct).

b: KKR & CO INC/ ENERGY CAPITAL PARTNERS MANAGEMENT
com: Recommended cash scheme from Dragon Bidco (ECP/KKR), announced 27 Jul after a 5,800p approach was rejected in April: 6,525p/sh plus a contingent payment of up to 125p tied to the Nexora (technology) sale; c.£5.6bn. Final dividend of 147.22p paid separately. Offer declared final 2 Sep. Shareholders approved 18 Sep, but only 78.09% at the Scheme Meeting (Fidelity and Aviva had opposed the terms). Nexora sold to One Equity Partners for US$725m EV (9 Oct); contingent payment now expected to be c.42p, i.e. c.6,567p in total. Awaiting regulatory approvals and High Court sanction; completion expected Q1 2027.

Recommended €8.00/sh cash MBO by scheme from Bluefin Bidco (CEO Eamonn Rothwell and three other senior managers, with GIP preferred equity), announced 24 Jul; c.€1.2bn. MBO Team holds c.23.7% and is rolling most of it over. Strong opposition from Oxy Capital, Marathon, Janus Henderson and others; offer declared final 17 Aug. Meetings adjourned from 28 Aug when proxies fell short of 75%; scheme approved 10 Sep with 79.2% in favour. UK NSI clearance 2 Oct. Court sanction hearing 10 Nov; scheme expected to become effective in November 2026.

Possible cash offer from Barings (Baring International Investment, part of MassMutual) at €1.386/sh, c.€732m diluted, confirmed 28 Sep in response to speculation. Fifth proposal since the first approach on 5 Aug; 30.75% premium to the undisturbed €1.06. Board minded to recommend, subject to Barings' confirmatory due diligence and agreement of final terms. PUSU deadline 5pm 9 Nov.

Non-binding approach from International Resources Holding (IRH), the Abu Dhabi mining group backed by IHC, confirmed 6 Oct; no price disclosed. Shares rose c.27% on the news. Follows a failed take-private attempt by founder Michael Carvill and Oryx. PUSU deadline 17 November 2026.
